properties.project_name: Mission Rock Terry A Francois Boulevard Paseo (Pier 48 entry)
properties.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor lot lines: the north end of the Terry A Francois Boulevard lot 8719A003 between Block K, the Pier 48 lot 8719A001 and the China Basin Park lot 8719A005; named as a paseo in Mission Rock Design Controls Figure 3.1.1 (p.45), Section 4.3 (p.90) and Figure 3.6.1 (p.71).
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-17 (site-completeness pass against Design Controls Figure 3.1.1, which marks three paseos: Shared Public Way 4.2, Terry A Francois Boulevard 4.3 and Bridgeview Street 4.4). The first two paseos north of Exposition Street were built with Phase 1 and are their own real lots (8719B001 and 8719A007, now status.csv rows). This third one -- the stub of TAFB between Block K and Pier 48 that Figure 3.6.1 draws as a paseo with a vehicular turnaround plaza serving the pier -- has no lot of its own: it is the north tip of the TAFB right-of-way lot 8719A003. The polygon uses that lot's recorded vertices for its west (Block K / park-lot lobe), north (park lot) and east (Pier 48 lot) edges, and closes on the south by extending the north lot line of the Exposition Street lot 8719A010 east to the Pier 48 lot line. Area 7,783 sf. Not registered in verify_block_fill.py (no fill on Figure 6.2). Satellite imagery shows it as the paved road to the Pier 48 gate today. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: (a) The statement above that the first two paseos 'were built with Phase 1' rests on the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes (https://sfport.com/media/10214/download), which record staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure and describe 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park' as Port owned (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06), and on the Port's June 5, 2026 report (Phase 1 completed in 2025; 'The City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure'); neither names lots 8719B001 or 8719A007. The two lots are active DataSF Assessor parcels recorded 2020-06-12 (acdm-wktn). The Design Controls, this file's only earlier source_doc_url, say none of this. (b) The sentence 'Satellite imagery shows it as the paved road to the Pier 48 gate today' had no imagery source cited and was not re-checked; treat it as an unverified observation. (c) Vertex check against DataSF's lot vertices: three of the four vertices sit within 0.1 m of recorded lot corners; the south-east vertex, on the extended Exposition Street line, is about 23 m from the nearest recorded lot vertex. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, why_no_real_parcel reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'APPROXIMATE but high confidence on three edges (recorded lot lines); the south edge is the Exposition Street lot line extended ~23 m east, which is where the plan's Exposition Street right-of-way ends at TAFB. Planned (Design Controls Section 4.3.4: the boulevard 'will become a paseo'); no source read describes its current use. ANGLE CHECK: check_geometry_quality.py flags a 12.3-12.6 deg corner here (its tolerance is 12 deg). Three of this polygon's four vertices are real, recorded DataSF Assessor lot corners; the south-east vertex is not, since it closes the south edge on the extended Exposition Street line (see digitization_method). The flagged deviation is at two of the recorded corners, so it is the real lots' own shape (Bridgeview Way's paseo lot 8719A007 and the Exposition Street lot 8719A010 meet the park lot 8719A005 at a corner that is not exactly square), not a shear or a misread trace. Accepted; see docs/site-definition-of-done.md.'; why_no_real_parcel: 'Part of the Terry A Francois Boulevard right-of-way lot 8719A003 (DataSF Assessor parcels, recorded 2020-06-12; it also carries the roadway south of here and Channel Wharf); joining status.csv to it would paint the whole boulevard (our mapping rationale, not a statement of the Design Controls).'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE but high confidence on three edges (recorded lot lines); the south edge is the Exposition Street lot line extended ~23 m east, which is where the plan's Exposition Street right-of-way ends at TAFB. Planned (Design Controls Section 4.3.4: the boulevard 'will become a paseo'); no source read describes its current use. ANGLE CHECK: the map's automated shape check flags a 12.3-12.6 deg corner here (its tolerance is 12 deg). Three of this polygon's four vertices are real, recorded DataSF Assessor lot corners; the south-east vertex is not, since it closes the south edge on the extended Exposition Street line. The flagged deviation is at two of the recorded corners, so it is the real lots' own shape (Bridgeview Way's paseo lot 8719A007 and the Exposition Street lot 8719A010 meet the park lot 8719A005 at a corner that is not exactly square), not a shear or a misread trace. Accepted as is. How this shape was traced, including earlier versions, is logged in its data file in the public data repository (https://github.com/pierandpoint/record).
properties.why_no_real_parcel: Part of the Terry A Francois Boulevard right-of-way lot 8719A003 (DataSF Assessor parcels, recorded 2020-06-12; it also carries the roadway south of here and Channel Wharf); mapping this record from that lot would paint the whole boulevard (our mapping rationale, not a statement of the Design Controls).
properties.regulatory_context: Design Controls Section 4.3 / 3.6: the TAFB terminus is a paseo facilitating park and water-oriented access to Pier 48, with a kiosk and picnic area connecting the pier apron to China Basin Park (Figure 3.6.1).
properties.notes: Planned paseo at the north end of Terry A Francois Boulevard between Block K and Pier 48 (Design Controls Section 4.3.4: 'Terry A Francois Boulevard will become a paseo'). No source read describes its current use.
